tasks.short: Develop planting plans for productive gardens and aesthetic effects.

steps.what: Discuss actual gardening objectives, aesthetic wishes and maintenance capability with the client
Inspect actual site conditions, soil, light, space and existing planting
Choose actual species, combinations, productive uses, seasonal effects and planting arrangement
Draw the actual selected planting arrangement and populate labels and quantities in landscape CAD
Check the complete planting plan, quantities, spacing and suitability against actual objectives and site
Save the checked final planting plan

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} landscape-CAD plant symbols, labels and linked quantities. The architect still chooses plants and their arrangement, inspects the site and checks the complete plan; no automatic aesthetic design is claimed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native plant objects and linked schedule fields.
tasks.still_hard: Matching long-term growth, productive use and visual effects to the actual site.
tasks.human_edge: Compose planting that works for the client's place and care capacity.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drafting; planting design authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native landscape-CAD plant objects and linked schedules reduce repeated labels and quantities without selecting the planting design.

assumptions: Boundary is planting-plan development through actual plan save. Architect captures actual objectives in s1 and site conditions in s2, selects species, placement and spacing in s3, and enters design objects in s4. Plant-reference producers supply actual names and growth attributes; missing values or unsupported objects are manually drafted and checked.

Native first. Provisional29 drawing share includes full design-object entry; only repeated labels/schedules reduce. Existing native configuration earns zero. Shares not measured. Normal final plan QA counted in s5, no extra approval ceremony. Save1 fully retained.
unknowns: Current landscape-CAD features and actual drafting repetition
research_questions: Can native schedules preserve selected species, spacing and actual counts?

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked complete final planting plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional29 drawing units reduced40 percent saves11.6 minus1 upkeep=10.6; half eligible repetition gives4.8. Client15, site20, design25, final QA10 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage subcontractor work to ensure quality.

steps.what: Inspect actual subcontractor work against landscape design and quality requirements
Find and read current contract details, drawing revisions and relevant quality criteria
Discuss actual defects and agree justified corrective work or quality follow-up with subcontractors
Write and check actual quality findings and corrective instructions in the site record
outputs: checked quality record and corrective instructions

steps.what: Save the checked quality record
inputs: checked quality record and corrective instructions

steps.what: Send the checked corrective instructions to the actual subcontractor recipient
inputs: checked quality record and corrective instructions

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} and {CLM} links from the {PROJECT} quality record to actual contract and drawing revisions. Keep site inspection, quality judgement, subcontractor discussion and actual corrective writing human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current requirements while resolving defects.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked quality records and revisions.
tasks.still_hard: Judging workmanship and securing actual correction.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise site defects and resolve accountability fairly.
tasks.altitude: Less requirement hunting; quality responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked contract and drawing revisions reduce quality-context retrieval, not site inspection or actual subcontractor correction.

assumptions: Boundary is architect quality management and actual record/instructions; subcontractor physical work is not saved focal labour. Source producers supply contract IDs, drawing revisions and requirements; architect captures actual observations in s1 and instructions in s4. Missing links or conflicting requirements require manual review.

Native first. Provisional shares not measured; existing links earn zero. Full source reading and real site work retained. Ordinary record and recipient checking inside writing, no added approval ceremony. Save/send1 each fully retained.
unknowns: Current quality records and source links

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked corrective instructions and actual subcontractor recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional15 source units reduced25 percent saves3.75 minus0.5 upkeep=3.25; half eligible finding gives1.375. Site40, discussion35, writing8 and actions2 unchanged.

tasks.short: Present landscape plans and designs to public stakeholders.

steps.what: Select actual project plans, design rationale and evidence appropriate to the public audience
Assemble actual plans, figures and drawing captions in the presentation layout
Write accessible explanations of the selected actual design choices and limitations

loop.purpose: Draft public explanation of selected landscape choices
loop.input: Actual design rationale, selected messages and visuals
loop.check: Architect checks that explanations preserve actual design choices, impacts and uncertainty; rejects invented benefits, hidden tradeoffs and misleading visual captions.
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns explanation to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native visual templates handle fixed layout first; audience-appropriate explanation of selected choices needs variable prose.

steps.what: Check the complete final presentation, visuals, explanations and intended agency or community audience
Send the checked presentation to the authorised public meeting organiser
Present actual plans to public stakeholders and answer their questions
outputs: actual public presentation and stakeholder feedback

steps.what: Write and check actual project-relevant stakeholder feedback in the existing consultation record
inputs: actual public presentation and stakeholder feedback

steps.what: Save the checked actual consultation note

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} presentation layouts and linked {OTHER} drawings first. A bounded loop drafts accessible explanations of actual selected choices; the architect checks, sends and presents them and records actual feedback afterward.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated presentation assembly and explanation drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layouts and evidence-bounded prose drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining tradeoffs and responding to community concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Engage openly with stakeholders and defend actual design choices.
tasks.altitude: Less presentation preparation; public engagement remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked visuals and bounded explanation drafting reduce preparation while stakeholder discussion and actual feedback capture remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual presentation preparation, public delivery and required consultation entry. Project authors supply actual design versions and rationale; architect selects messages in s1 and captures any missing captions in s2-s3. Actual feedback comes only from s6; no prefilled consultation outcomes.

Native first. Provisional shares not measured. Existing linked layouts earn zero. Actual written consultation note only where required, not an invented report baseline. Draft and final checks counted; send/save1 each retained, no added approval ceremony.
unknowns: Actual presentation mix and required consultation records
research_questions: Do drafted explanations preserve actual impacts, uncertainty and design tradeoffs?

incremental.description: Maintain presentation mappings and audit explanation fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked complete final public presentation and organiser recipient
s7 checked actual consultation note after presentation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional visuals20 reduced40 saves8 and explanation19 reduced30 saves5.7; gross13.7 minus1.5 upkeep=12.2. Half eligible preparation gives5.35. Selection15, QA5, public presentation35, note4 and actions2 unchanged.

tasks.short: Develop marketing materials, proposals and presentations for new work.

steps.what: Check actual project examples, client permissions and opportunity requirements
Choose the actual offer, project scope, positioning and evidence appropriate to the opportunity
Assemble actual approved project images, credentials and scope fields in the chosen material layout
Write the actual marketing, proposal or presentation explanation for the selected offer

loop.purpose: Draft opportunity material prose from selected actual offer
loop.input: Selected offer, supported messages and approved project evidence
loop.output: Draft marketing, proposal or presentation copy
loop.check: Architect verifies each experience and benefit claim, actual proposed scope and exclusions; rejects invented clients, unsupported environmental benefits or unselected commitments.
loop.stop: Unsupported claims or two failed revisions returns copy to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native layouts handle fixed project fields first; opportunity-specific explanation needs variable prose.

steps.what: Check the complete final material, visual permissions, actual commitments and release destination
Save the checked final opportunity material
Send the exact checked material to its authorised marketing or proposal release owner

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} layouts fed by approved actual project evidence from {CRM} and document records. A bounded drafting loop explains the architect-selected offer, with full final checks before save and separate internal release handoff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated material assembly and opportunity-specific copy drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable layouts and evidence-bounded prose.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a credible offer and commitments for the actual opportunity.
tasks.human_edge: Judge project fit and represent real capabilities honestly.
tasks.altitude: Less material preparation; offer strategy and commitments unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native layouts and bounded drafting reduce opportunity-material preparation while offer selection and claim verification remain architect work.

assumptions: Boundary is architect development of actual marketing, proposal or presentation material through internal release handoff; separate publication or client submission belongs to the actual release owner and is not saved labour. Existing records supply actual project names, work scope, approved images and permission status; architect checks in s1 and chooses offer in s2. Missing evidence is manually assembled or omitted.

Native first. Provisional material mix and shares not measured. Existing templates earn zero. No invented client, result or environmental claim. Draft review and final QA counted; no added approval ceremony. Save/send1 each fully retained.
unknowns: Actual material mix and release ownership
research_questions: Do drafted materials preserve actual scope and avoid unsupported capability claims?

incremental.description: Maintain evidence fields and audit copy fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked complete final opportunity material
s5 checked final opportunity material and authorised internal release owner

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional layout20 reduced50 saves10 and prose24 reduced50 saves12; gross22 minus2 upkeep=20. Half eligible assembly/drafting gives9. Evidence15, offer20, final QA19 and actions2 unchanged.
